card.name: Decimal digit before percent and counts
card.fires_on: The digit after the decimal point in an adverse-event rate (like 1.3 or 0.2), right before the % sign and a bracketed count. Also fires once on a word that ends a quoted phrase.

modes.label: Decimal digit in a rate
modes.description: The last digit of a percentage in safety data, just before % and a count in parentheses.
modes.example: been observed in 0.1% (1/1308) of subjects while receiving OTEZLA, compared to 0.<<2>>% (1/506)

modes.label: Rate in a sentence about discontinuation
modes.description: A decimal digit of a percentage in text about stopping or withholding a drug.
modes.example: Diabetes led to the permanent discontinuation of YERVOY with nivolumab in 0.<<5>>% and withholding of YERVOY

modes.label: Word before a closing quote
modes.description: A rare case where the word ends a quoted phrase before a stray closing mark.

card.writes: It suppresses opening brackets and parentheses, so the next piece is not a bracket; it expects % first.
card.plain: It marks the last digit of a percentage in side-effect rates, just before the % sign and the count in brackets.
